integrity: A complete exact modular proof accompanies a standard-library finite cross-check; numerical tests are not used as infinite proof. No independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Determines only whether the rank-four prime 17 divides higher-power balancing window GCDs, not the complete GCD, the 17-adic valuation, or other primes; unindexed equivalent work remains a literature risk.
title: Exact rank-four prime divisibility across all powers of balancing-number window sums
